title: Row actions are Contact and Create work order
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor (view customers; edit customers to raise a work order), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab. For the location cases use a two-workplace org (on a one-workplace org the location filter is absent).
  3. A normal row, a Needs readings row, and a row whose customer has no phone and no email. Seed a customer with no phone/email for the last.
custom_steps:
1. Read a row's visible buttons and open its three-dot menu.
  2. Confirm a Needs readings row keeps every action.
  3. Look at the Contact button on a row whose customer has no phone and no email, and hover it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Row actions are Contact and Create work order, and behind the menu Mark complete, Skip and Open asset; a Needs readings row keeps every action.
  • Where the customer has no phone and no email, the Contact button has an orange border and a hover reading "No phone or email on file".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10570 (S13, The worklist); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S13; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
